edge_sample.source_text: definition Convergence in distribution: We say that $X_n$ converges in distribution to $X$ and write $X_n \xrightarrow{d} X$ if $\mathcal L(X_n) \xrightarrow{w} \mathcal L(X)$.
edge_sample.target_text: theorem Cramér-Wold: Let $X, X_1, X_2, \ldots$ be random variables in $\mathbb{R}^d$. Then $X_n \xrightarrow{d} X$ iff for every $a \in \mathbb{R}^d$, $\langle a, X_n \rangle \xrightarrow{d} \langle a, X \rangle$.
